texts.zh:
我们位于[from.target.GetName]的间谍首脑，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]，向我们报告了在[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]内筛查特工项目上的惨痛失败。来自[from.target.GetAdj]首都的发言显示[root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle]已经选择叛逃。

看上去[root.GetOperativeRole]对于[from.target.GetName]的文化和主体物种生出了同情，而背离了我们。我们的审查机制本来应该排除掉这样的异样，但是这次却失败了。
texts.en:
Our Spymaster in the [from.target.GetName], [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName], reports a drastic failure in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] process for screening operatives. Word from the [from.target.GetAdj] capital is that [root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle] has chosen to defect.

It seems that the [root.GetOperativeRole] has grown more sympathetic towards the culture and founding ethics of the [from.target.GetName], in opposition to our own. Our screening process has failed in that it is supposed to rule out such flakiness.

texts.zh:
我们位于[from.target.GetName]的间谍首脑，[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]，向我们报告了在[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]内筛查特工项目上的惨痛失败。来自[from.target.GetAdj]首都的发言显示[root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle]已经选择叛逃。

尽管我们本应当通过审查排除掉组织里的不忠，但[root.GetOperativeRole]还是被“变节”了——或是通过反间谍行动，或是通过培养对[from.target.GetName]的同情意识，而我们之前并没有注意到。
texts.en:
Our Spymaster in the [from.target.GetName], [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName], reports a drastic failure in [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] process for screening operatives. Word from the [from.target.GetAdj] capital is that [root.GetOperativeRoleIndefiniteArticle] has chosen to defect.

Despite the fact we are supposed to be able to screen out such disloyalty, the [root.GetOperativeRole] has been 'turned' - either by act of Counter-Espionage, or some innate sympathy towards [from.target.GetName] which we were unable to detect before.

tooltips.zh: 如果[from.target.GetName]在我国建立了间谍网，他们会得到针对他们阴谋的警告。如果他们的破译比我们的加密要高，他们有可能甄别出我们。
tooltips.en: If the [from.target.GetName] have a Spy Network on us, they will be warned of a plot against them. They may identify us if their Codebreaking is superior to our Encryption.

tooltips.zh: 如果[from.target.GetName]在我国建立了间谍网，他们有50%几率得到针对他们阴谋的警告。如果他们的破译比我们的加密要高，他们有可能甄别出我们。
tooltips.en: 50% chance that if the [from.target.GetName] have a Spy Network on us, they will be warned of a plot against them. They may identify us if their Codebreaking is superior to our Encryption.

texts.zh:
我们的加密措施抓获了一帮危险的潜伏者。这些潜在敌人似乎为[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，其阴谋原本会使许多[root.species.GetAdj]人民丧生并对我方造成显著破坏。

我们设法解密了他们携带着的各种材料，但没有一个材料能展现出他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；我们也无法断言他们下一步会做什么。我们获得的情报因而相对较少。

我们必须仔细考虑如何应对。也许我们希望隐藏自身的能力，在星系中的其他邻居面前假装无知。不过，我们也可以正大光明地谴责这次针对我们的未遂暴力袭击。
texts.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of dangerous infiltrators. These would-be hostiles appear to be working on behalf of the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], on a scheme which would have cost many [root.species.GetAdj] lives and caused us significant damage.

We have managed to decrypt various materials they were carrying, however none lays out the full scope of their plans against us; nor are we able to say with certainty what their next move may be. Our Intel gains are therefore relatively small.

We must carefully consider how to respond. We may wish to keep quiet about our own capabilities, feigning ignorance in front of our other galactic neighbors. We would, however, also be justified in publicly denouncing this planned act of violence against us.

texts.zh:
我们的加密措施抓获了一帮危险的潜伏者。这些潜在敌人似乎为[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，其阴谋原本会使许多[root.species.GetAdj]人民丧生并对我方造成显著破坏。

我们从他们身上武力夺取的材料中包括大量通讯日志，并且我们设法解密了日志。没有一份日志描述了他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；[hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj]的安保看上去至少相当有能量，我们只能获取零星的情报。我们获知的一切消息都算不上可靠。

尽管我们的愤怒来得合理正当，明智来讲我们需要考虑如何回应。我们可能希望隐藏自身的加密能力，在敌人面前假装无能。不过，我们也可以将[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]针对我们的未遂暴力行动公之于众，也许敌人中也会有人对我们表示同情。
texts.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of dangerous infiltrators. These would-be hostiles appear to be working on behalf of the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], on a scheme which would have cost many [root.species.GetAdj] lives and caused us significant damage.

Amongst the materials we forcibly extracted from them were a number of communication logs, which we have managed to decrypt. None describes the full scope of their plans against us; [hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj] security seems at least capable enough to yield only patchy Intel to us. Everything else we may extract from them is deemed unreliable information.

Despite the justified outrage we may wish to express, we would be wise to consider our response. We could keep quiet about our own Encryption skill, feigning ineptitude in front of our enemies. Were we to expose the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] for this planned act of violence against us, however, we might find those enemies even regarding us with sympathy.

texts.zh:
我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验明身份。

这些状似特工的[hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]们携带了各式牵连他人的物件，其中有些我们很容易解密。不过，我们怀疑这些东西是伪造的，用来误导或者欺骗我方。这些间谍或许的确替[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，但证据算不上确凿。

以防万一，保持密切地监视[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]或许是值得的。不过，保持沉默或许也有好处，以免走漏我们在安保方面相对虚弱的一面。
texts.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. They claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

These [hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]-looking operatives were carrying various incriminating items, some of which we were easily able to decrypt. We suspect, however, that these items are a fabricated distraction or ruse. These spies may indeed be working for the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], but the evidence is inconclusive.

It may be worthwhile keeping a closer watch on the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], just in case. However, it may also benefit us to keep quiet and not let slip the comparative weakness of our own security.

texts.zh:
我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验证。

这些状似特工的[hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]们携带了各式牵连他人的物件，其中有些我们很容易解密。不过，我们怀疑这些东西是伪造的，用来误导或者欺骗我方。这些间谍或许的确替[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，但证据算不上确凿。

我们可以对[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]进行报复——这样的行动甚至会被他国视作正当之举。不过，也有可能整起事件都是个诱饵，用来转移我们对真正敌人的注意力。
texts.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. Even under interrogation they claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

These [hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]-looking operatives were carrying various incriminating items, some of which we were easily able to decrypt. We suspect, however, that these items are a fabricated distraction or ruse. These spies may indeed be working for the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], but the evidence is inconclusive.

We could retaliate against the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] - such action may even be deemed justified by others. However, it's possible this entire incident is a clever lure, put in place to distract us from our true enemies.

label.zh: 整个星系都应该听听这个！
label.en: The galaxy shall hear of this!

tooltips.zh: [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]将会被通知自己的间谍被捕了
tooltips.en: The [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] will be informed that we caught their operatives.

label.en: Let them buy our silence in this matter.

label.zh: [from.GetName]不会对这种姿态给予太多关注。
label.en: The [from.GetName] would not pay much heed to such a gesture.

label.zh: [from.GetName]不会对这种姿态给予太多关注。
label.en: The [from.GetName] would not pay much heed to such a gesture.

tooltips.zh: [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]将会被通知自己的间谍被捕了
tooltips.en: The [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] will be informed that we caught their operatives.

texts.zh:
[from.GetName]指控我方进行敌对谍报活动。他们的宣称——我方派遣特工从事龌龊的侵略举动——完全是基于谎言、虚假消息和不实的论据之上。

不管理由如何，这一指控导致了[from.GetName]对我们的外交制裁。我们大概不会看到由此带来任何直接后果，但他们的盟友，甚或我们自己的盟友都不会对这种诋毁视而不见。
texts.en:
The [from.GetName] accuses us of hostile espionage. Their claims - that we sent operatives to conduct abhorrent acts of aggression against them - are built upon shaky and misattributed evidence.

Whatever the credibility or reasoning behind this allegation, it has resulted in a diplomatic sanction from the [from.GetName]. We are not likely to see any direct consequences from this, but it's unlikely this smear will go unnoticed by any of their other allies, or even our own.

label.en: It is of no concern to us.

texts.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，[from.GetName]，将我方情报人员当场抓获且要求外交支持。作为交换，他们同意不将我们的隐秘行动公诸星海。

有可能他们的指控并没有实际证据来支撑，但无论如何这一指控本身就足以对我们造成损害。不论动机如何，[from.GetName]已经要求从我方获得政治好处。
texts.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the [from.GetName], have caught us in the act and demanded political favors. In doing so, they have agreed not to expose our covert actions to the wider galaxy.

It's possible that no actual evidence backs up their claims - the accusation alone could cause us enough damage anyway. Whatever their motivation is, the [from.GetName] have claimed political leverage on us.

texts.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，[from.GetName]，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方行动公之于众！。

有可能他们并没有能够支撑这些指控且可以验证的证据——只有少数国家会选择相信他们。不过，单是这些指控本身可能就足以造成危害了。
texts.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the [from.GetName], have not only seen through our scheme but have chosen to expose us for our actions!

It's possible that no verifiable evidence backs up these claims - few may choose to believe them. The accusation alone may be damaging enough, however.

texts.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，[from.GetName]，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方的敌对行动公之于众！。

有可能他们并未对此掌握实际证据——他们也许只是试图虚张声势来侮辱我们，或者是从他们在星系中的邻居那里赢取支持。
texts.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the [from.GetName], have not only seen through our scheme but have decided to expose us for our actions against them.

It's possible that they hold no actual evidence for this - they may simply try to bluff their way to insulting us or earning favor with their galactic neighbors.

label.en: Two can play at that game.

texts.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工发现了一些不寻常的事情：有可靠线索表明，[insidious_plot_country.GetName]正阴谋欺骗我方！我们尚不掌握这一可疑的计划的具体细节，但据称其中包括对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。

虽然完全不清楚[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]是如何获知这些情报的。不过我们的特工追踪可疑的[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj]特工的努力似乎已经有了回报。但如果这些情报是真的，[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]可能只是艰辛地为我们收集了该情报。
texts.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered something unusual: credible hints that the [insidious_plot_country.GetName] are plotting to deceive us! We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.

Quite how this information came to be known by the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] is unclear. Our own operatives' efforts to tail suspected [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj] intelligence operatives seem to have paid off, though. If this intelligence is genuine, the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] may just have done the hard work of gathering it for us.

texts.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工揭露了一些谣言——[insidious_plot_country.GetName]正在密谋欺骗我们。我们尚不掌握这一可疑的计划的具体细节，但据称其中包括对我们以及我们的生活方式本身的破坏。

虽然完全不清楚[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]是如何获知这些情报的。不过我们的特工追踪可疑的[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj]特工的努力似乎已经有了回报。但如果这些情报是真的，[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]可能只是艰辛地为我们收集了该情报。
texts.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered rumors that the [insidious_plot_country.GetName] are plotting to deceive us. We have no exact details of their apparent scheme yet, but it seems set to try and undermine us and our way of life.

Quite how this information came to be known by the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] is unclear. Our own operatives' efforts to tail suspected [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj] intelligence operatives seem to have paid off, though. If this intelligence is genuine, the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] may just have done the hard work of gathering it for us.

texts.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工获悉了一些可靠的传闻，当地有针对我们的阴谋。似乎他们[insidious_plot_country.GetAdj]特工对于自身特工行为的保密性不太重视。

我们尚未掌握该暴露阴谋的具体细节，但据说其中涉及对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。
texts.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered credible rumors of a local plot against us. It seems their [insidious_plot_country.GetAdj] counterparts are somewhat careless about their own operational secrecy.

We have no exact details for their apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve a manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.

texts.zh:
我们被牵连进了一个针对[from.GetName]的阴谋中。这一指控是如此地含糊，以至于我们靠自己根本无从得知他们是否真的掌握了我们的把柄。

我们自己的间谍抗议说，这一指控毫无根据，声称这可能是我们目标之一的防御性、反间谍行动，抑或是来自第三方的抹黑。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。
texts.en:
We have been implicated in a plot against the [from.GetName]. So vague is the allegation that we cannot definitively state whether or not they are on to something.

Our own spies protest that the allegation is baseless, claiming this is likely either a defensive, counter-espionage response from one of our targets - or else a smear campaign being conducted by some third party. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.

texts.zh:
令人惊讶的是，我们被毫无来由地指控参与到针对[from.GetName]的阴谋中。这一指控十分荒谬，因为我们近来委实未曾发起对外的间谍活动——但另一方面，[from.GetAdj]根本不知道这一指控有多荒谬。

似乎不明身份的人在试图陷害我们，从而为他们自己的不轨行为开脱——抑或是单纯为了制造外交混乱。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。
texts.en:
Amazingly, we have been implicated in some vaguely-defined plot against the [from.GetName]. It's a ridiculous allegation, given our complete lack of foreign espionage activity so far - but then, the [from.GetAdj] would have no way of knowing how truly ridiculous the allegation is.

It would seem that parties unknown are attempting to frame us for their own misdemeanors - or perhaps simply to sow some diplomatic chaos. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.

texts.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工发现了一些可疑的证据，其表明[insidious_plot_country.GetName]意图在近期欺骗我们。

尽管该计划的细节尚不得而知，但据说其中涉及对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。间谍首脑[insidious_plot_spymaster.GetName]建议对这一情况保持谨慎，因为这些信息的获得过于容易，显得相当可疑。
texts.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered suspect evidence that the [insidious_plot_country.GetName] mean to deceive us in the near future.

We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it looks to involve manipulating our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life. Spymaster [insidious_plot_spymaster.GetName] advises caution, however, as the ease by which we came across this information is fairly suspect.

texts.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工发现了一些可疑的证据，证据表明他们意图在近期对我们发起一次误导性的反制行动。

尽管该计划的细节尚不得而知，但据说其中涉及对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。间谍首脑[insidious_plot_spymaster.GetName]建议对这一情况保持谨慎，因为这些信息的获得过于容易，显得相当可疑。
texts.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered suspect evidence that they mean to launch a deceptive counter-operation against us in the near future.

We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it looks to involve manipulating our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life. Spymaster [insidious_plot_spymaster.GetName] advises caution, however, as the ease by which we came across this information is fairly suspect.

label.zh: 这种潜在的恶行不可容忍。
label.en: This potential outrage cannot be tolerated.

label.zh: 这很可能是个陷阱，别管它。
label.en: This is likely a ploy. Ignore it.
